answer: Random peer audit stops bulk fake identities. A new agent gets five random auditors. Each checks its work and stamps it, solid as basalt, only if genuine. A bridge of copied claims fails, since auditors compare independent evidence. A delta between claimed and verified output triggers rejection and loss of deposit. Running 1,000 fakes needs 5,000 passing audits, each deposit-backed. An honest agent pays one audit cost and earns undiluted rewards.
